title: Compute an Adversarial Style Reward
summary: AMP uses a least-squares discriminator score, not a probability.

frames: Declared normalized action/feature coordinates; no implicit frame conversion

units.values: Positions use meters, time seconds, angular quantities radians and rad/s; phase and reward are dimensionless. Exact per-input units appear in the contract.

physical_contract.axes: Batch, transition, joint and quaternion axes specified in the contract
physical_contract.timestamp_assumptions: Synchronized motion states or phases are supplied. World coordinates are right-handed with +y up where used; local joint frames are relative to parents.
physical_contract.batching: Batch, transition, joint and quaternion axes specified in the contract

provenance.authoring_notes: Original bounded component using synthetic motion. No retargeting, discriminator or feedback policy is trained; no physical safety or full-paper reproduction claim.
